purpose: Independent post-change validation of the newly reauthored full manuscript before actual human target-reader revalidation. This validates the new manuscript only; it does not promote architecture and cannot close actual-human failures.

forbidden_before_pass_A_freeze: project_state or checkpoint conclusions about expected quality
pass_A_isolation.instruction: Read the bound new manuscript from beginning to end as the declared target-reader simulation, freeze a raw reader-experience trace, and do not infer what was changed or which prior defects were targeted.

pass_A_required: actual desire-to-continue locations and whether there are any
dialogue embodiment and whether speech floats as information transfer
cross-scene functional recurrence after masking names/props/lore
climax experiential voltage and last-step pressure
would seek another story in this mode
anti_false_positive: A fresh AI liking the prose is not human acceptance.
Scene-specific actions do not automatically rescue manuscript-level mechanical cadence.
Short dialogue is not automatically bad, but repeated question-answer handoffs must be judged at manuscript scale.
Embodied actions must change meaning/pressure/judgment/relationship/timing/distance/choice; generic tags do not count.
Event progress is not page-turn desire.
Working suspense model is not answer-specific curiosity.
Structural option compression is not felt climax voltage.
Formal PASS may not overwrite a frozen Pass-A reader-effect FAIL.
post_completion: Coordinator binds the raw report and decides whether the new manuscript is clean enough to hand directly to the actual human target reader. Regardless of AI result, actual human revalidation remains required before any failure closure or final freeze.
